page.name: Page
rules: The Canvas ground (#F2F3F1), Gilroy at 13px in Forest.
White is for controls and panels on the ground, each with a 1px Stone line.

column.name: Content column
rules: Pages fill the width beside the rail with 24px sides; reading text stops at 680px.

section.name: Section
rules: A block of a page: a 14px label (Signature headers) over its content, 24px from the next block.

section-heading.name: Section heading
rules: A section inside a page is named in 14px regular ink (Channels, Signature headers, Tunnel TLS mode).
A page or dialog title is 20px regular (page-title).

section-description.name: Section description
rules: 13px in Forest at 72 percent under a title or a field label.

hero.name: Page head
hero.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-1 px-6 py-4 border-b border-line
rules: A page opens with its head: a 24px regular title and a 13px muted line, ruled off from the page by a 1px Stone line.

hero-title.name: Page title
rules: 20px regular ink; never bold, never tracked.

hero-subtitle.name: Page description
rules: 13px in Forest at 72 percent, one line under the title.

eyebrow.name: Section label
rules: 12px regular in Forest at 80 percent, above a group of rows or a field.
Sentence case; never caps.

card.name: Card
rules: A white panel on the Canvas with a 1px Stone line and the 8px cut corner at the top-left (ds-cut-frame); nothing rounded, no shadow.

card-raised.name: Framed panel
rules: A white panel ringed by a 1px Stone line: a table body, a selected tab, a select. No drop shadow.

window.name: Fog well
rules: A Fog well inside a panel: a site chip, a data tag row, a read-only value.

window-bar.name: Code head
window-bar.tailwind: flex items-center gap-2 h-10 px-3 border-b border-line-code bg-code-head text-code-head-fg text-body
rules: The Fog head of a code block: the language at the left in DM Mono, a copy key at the right.

card-title.name: Card title
rules: 13px regular Forest; a section title is 16px regular.

body-text.name: Body text
rules: 14px ink; secondary copy under a title in #70637E.

caption.name: Caption
rules: 12px muted for small print (Will be displayed as, reCAPTCHA notes).

link.name: Link
link.tailwind: text-fg-brand no-underline transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:underline underline-offset-4
rules: Links are the ink, underlined 3px below the text; the underline darkens nothing else on hover.

button-primary.name: Primary button
button-primary.tailwind: ds-cut [--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-action-primary)] hover:[--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-action-primary-hover)] active:[--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-action-primary)] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-9 px-4 text-on-primary font-sans text-body font-medium leading-none whitespace-nowrap after:transition-[background-color] after:duration-150 after:ease-out active:after:duration-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-line-strong
rules: The one main action: a Forest key with the 8px cut corner, a white 13px medium label and an arrow. Hover steps to #3E443E; press steps back at once. One per view.

button-secondary.name: Framed button
button-secondary.tailwind: ds-cut-frame [--ds-shape-stroke:var(--ds-color-border-strong)] [--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-bg-default)] hover:[--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-bg-subtle)] active:[--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-bg-subtle-hover)] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-9 px-4 text-fg font-sans text-body font-medium leading-none whitespace-nowrap after:transition-[background-color] after:duration-150 after:ease-out active:after:duration-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-line-strong
rules: The second action: a white key with a 1px Forest line and the cut corner. Hover steps to Fog, press to Mist.

button-on-brand.name: Text action
button-on-brand.tailwind: inline-flex items-center gap-2 h-9 px-0 bg-transparent text-fg-secondary font-sans text-body font-medium leading-none whitespace-nowrap transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:text-fg outline-none focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-line-strong
rules: A text action: an 80 percent Forest label and the arrow, no fill or shape; the label turns Forest under the pointer and nothing moves.

header.name: Rail
header.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-1 w-(--ds-layout-rail) p-3 border-r border-line bg-surface
rules: Navigation lives in a 212px white rail at the left with a 1px Stone line at its edge: the mark, then square rows grouped under 12px labels.
There is no top bar on a desktop screen.

header-action.name: Head action
header-action.tailwind: ds-cut-frame [--ds-shape-stroke:var(--ds-color-border-strong)] [--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-bg-default)] hover:[--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-bg-subtle)] active:[--ds-shape-fill:var(--ds-color-bg-subtle-hover)] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-9 px-4 text-fg font-sans text-body font-medium leading-none whitespace-nowrap after:transition-[background-color] after:duration-150 after:ease-out active:after:duration-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-line-strong
rules: An action in a page head is the framed key.

nav-link.name: Rail row
nav-link.tailwind: flex items-center gap-2 h-8 px-3 text-fg text-body font-normal no-underline transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-subtle aria-[current=page]:bg-subtle-hover outline-none focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-line-strong
rules: 32px square rows: a 16px glyph and a 13px regular label in Forest; Fog under the pointer, Mist for the current page.

nav-dock.name: Second rail
nav-dock.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-1 w-(--ds-layout-rail) p-3 bg-page
rules: A second rail sits on the Canvas beside the white one; its current row is white.

chip.name: Tag
chip.tailwind: inline-flex items-center h-6 px-2 bg-tag text-tag-fg font-mono text-caption font-normal leading-none
rules: Data tags are square Fog chips with Forest ink in DM Mono ("345 kV", "41.2 ac"). Status is a diamond, never a colored chip.

stat.name: Status well
stat.tailwind: inline-flex items-center h-8 px-3 bg-success-bg text-fg text-body
rules: A state is shown as a 38px well with fully rounded corners: green for active, gray for idle, blue for a mode (Active, Idle, Edge).

code-window.name: Code block
code-window.tailwind: overflow-hidden border border-line bg-code text-code-text font-code text-body leading-body
rules: Code is light: an off-white body with the editor's gray edge and head, line numbers in teal, red keys and blue values.
Never a dark code block.

media-frame.name: Media frame
rules: Photos sit square in a Fog frame, dimmed under map marks (ds-imagery).
media-frame.source: Extrapolated from the Mireye product UI boards (442:2)

table.name: Table
rules: The head is 12px Forest at 80 percent on a 1px Stone rule; rows are 13px with 1px Mist rules; values with units are DM Mono. Each cited value ends in its source number.
No fills, no corners, no shadow.

faq.name: Collapsible row
faq.tailwind: flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3 text-body text-fg
rules: A disclosure is a 14px ink row with a caret at its right (Advanced settings - tunnel mode, phone state, line sharing).

tabs.name: Tabs
rules: Tabs sit on a 1px Stone rule; the chosen tab is Forest with a 1px Forest line under it, the rest 72 percent Forest.

input.name: Field

css.transition: border-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), box-shadow var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

input.tailwind: h-9 px-3 border border-line bg-surface text-fg font-sans text-body leading-tight outline-none transition-[border-color] duration-150 ease-out placeholder:text-fg-subtle focus-visible:border-line-strong aria-invalid:border-danger disabled:bg-subtle disabled:text-fg-subtle
rules: Fields are 36px white frames with a 1px Stone line; focus turns the line Forest, no ring. A unit (ac, ft, kV) sits at the end in the secondary ink.

logo-strip.name: Logo row
logo-strip.tailwind: flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 p-0.5 bg-subtle
rules: A row of sources or tools is a Fog track of square tiles with 13px ink names.

footer.name: Rail foot
footer.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-1 p-3 border-t border-line-subtle
rules: The rail ends with help, the organization (with an ADMIN mark), the account and Collapse, ruled off above.

menu-panel.name: Menu panel
menu-panel.tailwind: bg-surface p-1 font-sans text-body text-fg border border-line outline-none
rules: Menus and select lists are white with a 1px Stone line, square, 4px inside, 8px from the trigger. No shadow.
menu-panel.source: Extrapolated from the Mireye product UI boards (442:2)

menu-item.name: Menu item
menu-item.tailwind: flex items-center gap-2 min-h-9 px-3 py-2 text-fg text-body outline-none data-[highlighted]:bg-subtle
rules: Square 36px rows, 13px Forest; Fog on the highlighted row with no fade; a chosen row ends in the check glyph.
menu-item.source: Extrapolated from the Mireye product UI boards (442:2)

glass-menu.name: Floating panel
rules: Mireye has no glass: floating panels are the white framed panel.
glass-menu.source: Extrapolated from the Mireye product UI boards (442:2)

glass-menu-item.name: Floating panel item
glass-menu-item.tailwind: flex items-center gap-2 min-h-9 px-3 py-2 text-fg text-body
rules: As a menu item.
glass-menu-item.source: Extrapolated from the Mireye product UI boards (442:2)

popover-panel.name: Popover panel
rules: Popovers are the white framed panel with 16px inside.
popover-panel.source: Extrapolated from the Mireye product UI boards (442:2)
